Pyodide 0.27.3 source availability
==================================

OpenAtelierUI distributes the published Pyodide 0.27.3 browser runtime as a
third-party component. OpenAtelierUI itself remains licensed under
BSD-3-Clause. Pyodide and every embedded dependency retain their own licenses.

Exact upstream source
---------------------

Project: Pyodide
Version: 0.27.3
Git commit: 584d055066f1a94bae719a7e5752c314c04e7858
Tag: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.27.3
Immutable source archive:
https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/archive/584d055066f1a94bae719a7e5752c314c04e7858.tar.gz

License scope
-------------

The Pyodide project source tag and project documentation declare MPL-2.0. The
same source tag declares the JavaScript package in src/js/package.json as
Apache-2.0. The bundled CPython runtime, OpenBLAS library and Python wheels
retain their respective licenses. The accompanying license and notice files do
not relicense any component.

OpenAtelierUI does not patch upstream Pyodide source files. Its build copies
the published 0.27.3 runtime and adds separately maintained package selection,
lock data and license evidence. If OpenAtelierUI later modifies an MPL-covered
Pyodide source file, that modified file must remain available under MPL-2.0.
